NASA Space Apps Challenge kapsamında bilimsel araştırmalar yaparak uzay keşfine katkı sağlayacak yaratıcı ve uygulanabilir çözümler üretmeyi hedefliyoruz.

Ekibimize yazılım, yapay zekâ, mühendislik, robotik, veri analizi, astronomi ve grafik tasarım alanlarında yetkin; araştırmaya, öğrenmeye ve takım çalışmasına açık kişiler arıyoruz.

details:
LUNAR SAFE is a smart living capsule prototype developed to detect potential hazards and improve the safety of astronauts entering and leaving their living spaces on the Moon. The main goal of our project is to create an automated safety system that can identify possible dangers in advance and reduce the need for human intervention.

How Does It Work?

Our project combines a gas sensor, a distance sensor, a display, and a motor to create an integrated safety system. The gas sensor monitors changes in detectable gas levels in the environment, while the distance sensor detects approaching objects around the capsule. Data received from the sensors is evaluated by the control system. When a hazardous situation is detected, the display shows an "UNSAFE" warning, and the capsule door automatically closes using the motor. Once the danger has passed, the door reopens after a predetermined waiting period. In this way, the system monitors environmental conditions and automatically responds to potential hazards.

Benefits and Intended Impact

LUNAR SAFE aims to improve astronaut safety, provide early warnings against potential hazards, and reduce risks caused by human error. Automatic door control helps protect the living area when dangerous conditions are detected. The display also provides real-time safety information, helping astronauts make faster decisions about their environment.

Technologies and Hardware Used

We used a gas sensor, a distance sensor, an electronic control system, an information display, a motor, and connecting components to develop our prototype. Data collected by the sensors is evaluated through the control system, which manages the operation of the display and motor. The software is designed to read sensor data, make decisions based on predefined conditions, and control the automatic door mechanism.

Innovative and Creative Aspects

The most innovative feature of our project is the integration of multiple sensors into a single smart safety system. The system does not simply detect danger; it also informs astronauts and automatically takes safety measures. Combining detection, warning, and physical response mechanisms in one functional prototype makes our project practical and open to further development.

Factors Considered by Our Team

While designing our project, we considered astronaut safety, early detection of environmental hazards, automatic control, ease of use, and system reliability. We also took into account the challenging conditions of the lunar environment, the importance of protecting living spaces, and the priority of human safety in future space missions.

Importance for NASA and Future Development Goals

LUNAR SAFE presents a prototype concept for safety technologies that could be further developed to support NASA's goal of establishing a long-term human presence on the Moon through the Artemis program. In the future, additional sensors for oxygen, pressure, carbon dioxide, and lunar dust detection could be integrated to transform the system into a more comprehensive life-support and safety system. Furthermore, multiple capsules could be connected to create a smart lunar living station.

For us, LUNAR SAFE is not just a capsule model; it is an idea for protecting the safety of people who may live on the Moon and Mars in the future through technology.

Our main message: Detect danger, warn astronauts, protect life! AI
